To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the diffusion expansion for the integrals describing Coulomb collisions between electrons is obtained for the first time, and that the effect of the Coulomb collisions on coherence of the interaction is studied.
the effect of Coulombs collisions between nonequilibriums electrons during interband relaxation in semiconductors is negligible in comparison to the effect of the intraband relaxation.

Coulomb collisions between non-equilibrium electrons during inter-band interaction of high-power pulses with semicondcutors and insulators lead to a diffusion expansion of integrals of the Coulomb collision operator that is responsible for relaxation of particle distribution functions and for polarization induced by the interaction, and that this expansion can be used to analyze the effect of Coulmb collisions on the coherence between the field and medium.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the influence of the electron-electron interaction on the relaxation of nonequilibrium electron distributions in semiconductors.
the interaction of high-power laser radiation with semiconducting crystals and insulators.
the development of a theoretical framework for the analysis of nonlinear optical phenomena in semiconductors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Coulomb interaction between electrons is the dominant mechanism in the relaxation of the particle and polarization distribution functions.
the effect of Coulumb collisions on the coherence is small and can be ignored in most situations.
the theory of Coulomb collisions in the presence of a strong electromagnetic field is not yet complete.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effect of Coulumb collisions on the interaction is negligible for all the cases we considered.
the diffusion expansion for the Coulomb collision integrals is a powerful method for studying the nonequilibrium dynamics in semiconductors.

the effect of Coulom collisions on the coherence is small for the case of interband interaction of optical pulses with semicoductors and insulators, if the pulse duration is shorter than the time of relaxation of the electron distribution functions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Coulomb collisions between the particles of a semiconductor and insulator are not responsible for the relaxation of the polarization induced by inter-band interaction with a high-power optical field, and the coherence of the medium is preserved.
Coulomb collisions between electrons are important for the description of the relaxation of the nonequilibrium electron distribution function and polarization induced by a high-power optical field.
the coherence of the optical response is destroyed by the Coulomb collisions, and this is the main reason for the difference between the results of our work and those obtained in previous works.
